questions.q: Project 18A, approved by the Defence Acquisition Council, is a programme for:
questions.explanation: A **₹80,000-crore destroyer** programme with ~75% indigenous content.

questions.q: Gross GST collection in October 2026 was:
questions.explanation: **₹2.31 lakh crore**, up 23%.

questions.q: The 2027-28 Union Budget allocated how much to the Department of Space?
questions.explanation: **₹17,000 crore**, up from ₹13,705.6 crore.

questions.q: India's installed solar capacity has grown from 2.8 GW in 2014 to about:
questions.explanation: About **171 GW**; target 500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030.

questions.q: Bhutan dedicated Chorten No. 76 of its 108 stupas to:
questions.explanation: To **PM Narendra Modi**, as part of the Gelephu Mindfulness City project.

questions.q: National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas) is observed on:
questions.explanation: **31 October**, Sardar Patel's birth anniversary (151st in 2026).

questions.q: The motto adopted by the new IAF chief Ashutosh Dixit is:
questions.explanation: **Nabha Sparsham Deeptam** (also the IAF's motto), with the 'VAYU' framework.

questions.q: Whom did Ashutosh Dixit succeed as Chief of the Air Staff?
questions.explanation: **A.P. Singh**, who retired after 43 years.

questions.q: Which city did Amit Shah say will be India's first drug-free city?
questions.explanation: **Chandigarh**, with a 93% conviction rate in NDPS cases.

questions.q: EPFO celebrated which Foundation Day in 2026?
questions.explanation: The **74th**; corpus over ₹32 lakh crore.

questions.q: Who won the 97th MCC-Murugappa Gold Cup hockey title?
questions.explanation: **Indian Navy**, beating BPCL 5-4 in a shootout.

questions.q: P.V. Sindhu and Lakshya Sen won singles titles at the Hylo Open Super 500, held in:
questions.explanation: **Saarbrücken, Germany**.

questions.q: Who became the highest run-scorer in a bilateral T20I series (341 runs vs India)?
questions.explanation: **Glenn Phillips**, passing Phil Salt's 331.

questions.q: India won the 2026 T20I series in New Zealand by what margin?
questions.explanation: **3-2**; captain Shreyas Iyer's first series win in a SENA country.

questions.q: The inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship was held in:
questions.explanation: **Ahmedabad**; India won both the men's and women's titles.

questions.q: According to PLFS, India's unemployment rate fell from 6.1% in 2017-18 to what in 2023-24?
questions.explanation: **3.2%**, though the Decent Work Index rose only from 0.247 to 0.302.

questions.q: The UNGA has passed a resolution against the US embargo on Cuba every year since:
questions.explanation: Since **1992**. India voted in favour again.

questions.q: The RBI's inflation-targeting band for CPI inflation is:
The long-period average (LPA) of India's southwest monsoon rainfall is about:
questions.explanation: About **87 cm**; 2026 ended nearly 13% below it.

questions.q: The Lyngdoh Committee (2006) is associated with rules for:
questions.explanation: **Student union elections** in colleges and universities.

questions.q: Where did the INDIA bloc hold its rally against the SIR?
questions.explanation: **Ramlila Maidan**, Delhi; the BJP held a counter-rally on the 1984 riots.

questions.q: Over 1,000 discrepant entries after the SIR were found in which city's rolls?
questions.explanation: **Bengaluru**, including the Dasarahalli constituency.

questions.q: Under which Schedule did the RJD seek the disqualification of two Bihar MLCs?
questions.explanation: The **Tenth Schedule** (anti-defection).

questions.q: West Bengal aims to give CAA citizenship to 2.5 lakh people of which community?
questions.explanation: **Matuas**, Hindu Namasudras with roots in Bangladesh.

questions.q: Turnout in Andhra Pradesh's 2026 urban local body polls was:
How many cases are pending in India's High Courts, per the CJI?
questions.explanation: **65,54,788**, with 292 judicial vacancies against a sanctioned 1,122.

questions.q: India's power consumption in October 2026 grew by:
questions.explanation: **21.88%** year-on-year, to 159.76 billion units.

questions.q: A 19-kg commercial LPG cylinder in Delhi cost how much after the November revision?
questions.explanation: **₹2,820**; Kolkata's rose to ₹2,971. Domestic LPG was unchanged.

questions.q: Foreign Portfolio Investors withdrew how much from Indian equities in October?
questions.explanation: **₹34,843 crore**, a second straight month of outflows.

questions.q: Comex gold fell in October 2026 to a one-year low of about:
questions.explanation: **$3,884.9 an ounce**, down 7.26%; silver fell 19.1%.

questions.q: On day one of Delhi's entry curbs, how many vehicles were turned back?
questions.explanation: **714** of 7,279 checked; 38 end-of-life vehicles were impounded.

questions.q: Cyclone Arnab's losses in Andhra Pradesh were estimated at:
questions.explanation: **₹4,600 crore**, with 3.5 lakh hectares of crops submerged.

questions.q: Delhi's planned 3.3-km heritage corridor runs along:
questions.explanation: **Netaji Subhash Marg**, from Delhi Gate to Kashmere Gate.

questions.q: China's CPC Fifth Plenum confirmed the expulsion of how many Central Committee members?
questions.explanation: **33**, including 16 PLA generals.

questions.q: What did Iran's Revolutionary Guards say a renewed war would have?
questions.explanation: '**No geographic limitations**', Iran warned.

questions.q: Lula beat Flavio Bolsonaro in the runoff by what margin?
Pakistan told which government that 'terrorism is a red line'?
questions.explanation: Afghanistan's **Taliban** government.

questions.q: Harvard's ElectIt model forecast Democrats winning how many of 435 House seats?
questions.explanation: **230**, plus 18 of the 35 contested Senate seats.

questions.q: Mahadev Online Book promoter Sourabh Chandrakar was extradited from:
questions.explanation: **Oman**, after an Interpol Red Corner Notice.

questions.q: Azam Khan's PMLA case relates to land taken for which institution?
questions.explanation: **Mohammad Ali Jauhar University**, Rampur.

questions.q: Which group did Chainalysis blame for the $6.3-billion Binance hack?
questions.explanation: North Korea's **Lazarus Group**, via 'TraderTraitor'.

questions.q: The alleged rape inside a police station that led to three arrests was in:
questions.explanation: **Seraikela, Jharkhand**; an SIT was formed.

questions.q: Which university ordered a probe into a first-year student's molestation complaint?
questions.explanation: **Jadavpur University**, Kolkata.

questions.q: West Bengal offered Group D jobs to families of those killed in political violence over the past:
questions.explanation: **25 years**, with an income cutoff of ₹50,000 a month.

questions.q: Carlos Alcaraz won which title by beating Alex de Minaur?
options: Erste Bank Open final in Madrid
questions.explanation: The **Vienna Open**, his fourth title of 2026.

questions.q: Marc Marquez closed on which milestone after winning the Malaysian GP?
questions.explanation: An **eighth MotoGP world title**; his lead grew to 399 points.

questions.q: Manav Thakkar won his first international singles title at:
questions.explanation: **WTT Feeder Chennai**, beating England's Samuel Walker.
